interpretation: The narrator's temporal clause refers to Jesus' resurrection, rather than only quoting a character's belief. Chapters 26–28 were materialized and read together: death and burial at 27.50,57–61 precede the angel's announcement and Jesus meeting the women at 28.5–10. This records what the canonical narrative presents; it does not establish historical occurrence, authorship, eyewitness access, or the truth of its narrated phenomena.
